subject.title: feat(agents): configured agent env reaches spawned subprocesses

question: Should OpenClaw accept broad literal `agents.list[].env` for CLI, exec, ACP/ACPX, and stdio MCP child processes, or prefer the narrower exec-only SecretRef direction in PR #96309?
rationale: The patch changes a public config and credential-handling boundary across several runtime owners, and automation cannot choose the permanent security and compatibility contract.

options.title: Choose the canonical env contract first
options.body: Resolve broad literal per-agent env versus the narrower SecretRef/exec-only model, then require this PR or the alternative to match that decision before merge.

options.title: Accept this broad contract
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical sanitized child-process env surface once checks are refreshed and green.

options.title: Pause behind exec-only SecretRef
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it later only if the exec-only SecretRef path becomes the accepted and merged implementation.

recommendation.title: Choose the canonical env contract first
recommendation.body: Resolve broad literal per-agent env versus the narrower SecretRef/exec-only model, then require this PR or the alternative to match that decision before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the predecessor PR's concrete viable-fix requirements and has recent config/env-path history relevant to the public env contract.
